title: Iceland Ring Road, 2–10 October 2026

flights.notes: Lands 23:55. Car desk after immigration puts you on the road ~00:40, hotel ~01:00. Day 1 departs 08:00 — that is a short night by design.
Different airline from the outbound — Wizz baggage allowance is stricter than LOT's, check before packing. Route reaches the airport 18:55, so ~5h spare.

bookings.notes: Check-in window closes 00:30. Car is booked for 01:00 and the drive from the terminal is ~8 min, so arrival is roughly 01:10 — after the window shuts. Contact the host for a key box or late arrival.
Skagaströnd, not Blönduós — 24 km further north. Adds ~27 min to the end of Oct 3 and ~20 min to the start of Oct 4; both days absorb it.

Rebooked from Akureyri — back on the lake, which removes ~180 km of out-and-back over Oct 4 and Oct 5. Phone/website are the adjoining Hlíð campsite under the same operator; confirm reception hours for a late arrival.
Pin sits ~11 km south-west of Egilsstaðir centre — check the exact approach before dark.

Replaces Kirkjustræti 2 — 800 m further west, by the old harbour. Rated 9.8 from 21 reviews. Confirm check-in time and whether parking is included; 101 Reykjavík is paid/zoned and the car is with us until 20:00 on the 10th.

tours.name: Jökulsárlón zodiac boat tour
tours.meetingPoint: Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon car park, Route 1
tours.notes: Fixed departure. Route now leaves Höfn 07:15 and reaches the lagoon 09:12, giving 38 min for check-in and the flotation suit. Block runs to 11:07 to cover de-suiting. Still need the operator name, confirmation number and their stated check-in time.

tours.name: Katla ice cave (Mýrdalsjökull)
tours.notes: Fixed departure. Day now leaves Brekkur 1 at 08:30 and reaches the meeting point 08:43. Víkurfjara moved to AFTER the tour since it returns you to Vík. Still need operator name and confirmation number.

tours.name: Sólheimajökull glacier hike
tours.meetingPoint: Sólheimajökull car park, end of Road 221
tours.notes: Fixed 14:30 departure — kept deliberately. Day starts 08:32, at the car park 14:00, off the ice ~17:30, at Brekkur 1 ~18:08 against an 18:25 sunset. 17 minutes of margin is accepted: the final 23 km is Route 1 in dusk. If the tour overruns, that leg is done in the dark — which is fine on that road.

tours.name: Blue Lagoon
tours.notes: Entry is a timed slot, not a time limit. Day now starts 07:30 to arrive 15:51. Planned to leave 19:00 so the car is back by 20:00; sunset 18:31 falls inside the soak. If the car return can be pushed to 21:00 you could stay until 20:00 instead.

car.model: Kia Sorento Plug-in Hybrid or similar
car.spec: Kia Sorento PHEV or similar · automatic · 4x4 · 5 doors · 5 seats · 4 large bags · 23+ only · unlimited mileage

pickup.place: Keflavík Intl Airport — Hertz counter in the ARRIVALS HALL, just after customs

car.insurance: MAX coverage — upgraded after the original booking. Supersedes the Zero Insurance Pack SWST on confirmation 902184. Exact inclusions NOT YET VERIFIED against a written confirmation; in particular whether gravel damage is now covered, and what the remaining non-waivable excess is.
car.notes:
Bring the DRIVING LICENCE and a CREDIT CARD IN VITALII'S NAME — the counter asks for both.
Return with a FULL TANK or Hertz charges the difference at their own rate.
NO F-ROADS, and no 35 Kjolur / 550 Kaldidalur / 208 Landmannalaugar. Plug-in hybrids are banned from them by name even though this is a 4x4. Penalty 150,000 ISK plus uninsured damage. Our route contains none of these and none should be improvised.
Pickup 01:00 is 65 min after the 23:55 landing. Counter is in the Arrivals Hall, after customs.
Original booking 153,444 ISK paid in full; the MAX upgrade is on top of that.
car.priceNote: 153,444 ISK is the ORIGINAL total. The MAX upgrade cost is not yet recorded.

restrictions.summary: The signed declaration bans PLUG-IN HYBRID, electric, luxury and 2WD vehicles from F-roads and three named roads — even though ours is a 4x4. Breach = 150,000 ISK fee under Article 10, plus the damage is uninsured.
bannedRoads: Any road marked F on official maps
restrictions.note: This is a USE restriction, not an insurance option — MAX coverage does not lift it. It is also largely moot in October: the highland roads are shut for the season and our route was audited leg by leg and contains none of them.
restrictions.routeVerified: All 40 legs re-checked against the contract ban list. No F-road, no 550 Kaldidalur, no 208 Landmannalaugar. Road 35 is used on Oct 10 for the Golden Circle — that is the PAVED Biskupstungnabraut south of Gullfoss, which is not the banned Kjolur. The route's northernmost point on 35 is 64.3289, about 200 m past the falls (the car park exit, which OSM labels Kjalvegur); the highland Kjolur track begins around 64.36 and we never reach it.
